title: extensions.write_budget
description: The ceiling on unsaved writes a graph served from a mapped .kgl holds in memory. 'limit' is 'default' (max(512 MiB, half the file)), 'unlimited', a byte count, or a size with a K, M or G suffix such as '2GiB'. A warning comes at half the limit; at the limit writes fail until the graph is saved. The --write-budget flag overrides it. The setting is runtime only and never written into a .kgl file; an in-memory graph and a graph with no mapped topology carry no budget.

limit.description: 'default', 'unlimited', a byte count or a size such as '2GiB'.
